masjid.title: The boatmen's masjid
masjid.text: A small masjid of reed and timber at the far end of the bridge. The floor moves gently with the river. The imam, Uthman, was a boatman himself.
masjid.first: After the prayer the imam, Uthman, asks where you are from. “Whoever prays with us is no stranger here.”
